_about: 내 데이터로 LLM 파인튜닝하기 8장 사양표. 모든 값은 각 항목의 url을 checked 날짜에 직접 읽고 옮겼다. 값이 바뀌면 이 파일을 고치지 말고 날짜가 다른 새 파일을 만든다. 1GB = 10^9바이트. claim=회사 주장은 Unsloth가 스스로 밝힌 수치로, 이 실습이 재현한 값이 아니다.

unsloth.license: core Apache-2.0, Unsloth Studio UI 등 일부 선택 구성요소 AGPL-3.0 (README License 절)
unsloth.readme_quote_train: Train LLMs, diffusion, decision, TTS, and embedding models 2× faster with 70% less VRAM with no accuracy loss
unsloth.readme_quote_methods: Supports reinforcement learning, LoRA, QLoRA, full fine tuning, pretraining, RL, GRPO, DPO, and FP8.
unsloth.readme_quote_export: Export or Deploy models including GGUF, NVFP4, FP8 and more formats.
unsloth.readme_quote_hw: We support Multi GPU setups, NVIDIA, AMD, Intel GPUs, CPUs and the Vulkan backend.

requirements.core_quote: Minimum CUDA Capability 7.0 (V100, T4, Titan V, RTX 20 & 50, A100, H100, L40 etc)
requirements.vram_table_note: QLoRA uses 4-bit, LoRA uses 16-bit. Keep in mind that sometimes more VRAM is required depending on the model so these numbers are the absolute minimum
requirements.oom_hint: A common issue when you OOM or run out of memory is because you set your batch size too high. Set it to 1, 2, or 3 to use less VRAM.

kernels.quote: By manually deriving backpropagation steps and rewriting all Pytorch modules into Triton kernels, Unsloth can both reduce memory usage and make fine-tuning faster. Crucially, accuracy degradation is 0% with respect to normal QLoRA, because no approximations are made in the optimized code.
kernels.author: Daniel (Unsloth), Hugging Face 블로그 게스트 글

gradient_checkpointing.quote: Unsloth Gradient Checkpointing reduces memory usage by a further 30% at the cost of +1.9% extra time overhead ... We asynchronously offload activations to system RAM
gradient_checkpointing.fetch_note: 직접 요청은 403이라 r.jina.ai 읽기 도구를 거쳐 원문을 읽었다

packing.quote: Speedup = batchsize × L / (batchsize/2 L + batchsize/2 S) = 2 L / (L + S)
packing.note: 식 자체는 산수라 실습에서 재현한다. '3x', '5x' 같은 속도 수치는 회사 주장이다.

grad_accum_fix.quote: Gradient accumulation and batch sizes are now fully equivalent in Unsloth due to our bug fixes for gradient accumulation.

prequantized.quote: 4bit pre quantized models we support for 4x faster downloading + no OOMs.

official_notebook.dtype_comment: None for auto detection. Float16 for Tesla T4, V100, Bfloat16 for Ampere+

trl.bf16_rule_quote_latest: bf16: Defaults to True if fp16 is not set, instead of False.
trl.bf16_rule_v0222_source: self.bf16 = not (self.fp16) if self.bf16 is None else self.bf16

colab.quote_limits: overall usage limits as well as idle timeout periods, maximum VM lifetime, GPU types available, and other factors vary over time. Colab does not publish these limits
colab.quote_12h: In the version of Colab that is free of charge notebooks can run for at most 12 hours, depending on availability and your usage patterns.
colab.free_gpu_type: [확인 필요] Google FAQ는 GPU 종류를 밝히지 않는다. Unsloth 문서는 'T4 is the free GPU Google is providing'이라고 적는다(회사 주장).
colab.unsloth_quote_t4: T4 is the free GPU Google is providing.

gpu_t4.name: NVIDIA T4
gpu_t4.note: 65 FP16 TFLOPS는 Tensor Core 혼합정밀도 최고치(제조사 표기)다. 실제 학습은 이보다 훨씬 낮게 나온다.
